headline: Meta opens its models as Wall Street lines up $500B
body: Two big moves pulled in opposite directions. Meta released Muse Glimmer, a roughly 30B open model, and said it will open the weights of its frontier Muse Spark 1.2. Zuckerberg urged the US to remove barriers to open AI. Wider access lowers Power Concentration, lifting Libertarian Utopia and pulling down 1984, Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator. At the same time, Nvidia and firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, KKR and Blackstone lined up about $500 billion for data centers and fabs. That raises Capability Velocity and concentrates power, lifting Enslaved God, Zookeeper and Descendants. Smaller items: South Australia launched a royal commission on AI, Unitree filed for an IPO, and South Korea set up a chip fund. Horizon Balance improved to -1.95.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.3 came from Meta's open-weights move (+0.48), partly offset by the $500B infrastructure push (-0.15); 1984 -0.3 came from Meta (-0.32); Descendants +0.3 came mainly from the infrastructure push (+0.21).
